reviews.text:
We went here twice with our tomcat kitten and both times we received really good and friendly service.

The first time I had accidentally booked an appointment for the next day, but when we arrived, they still accepted us because they wanted to make sure the cat got help as quickly as possible. We were given medication and our cat was treated really well.

The neutering also went well and the wound healed quickly without any problems. The day after the neutering, we also received quick help by phone when the cat had an upset stomach. We are really happy with the care and service, and the prices are right. Enkidu thanks!
Great place, friendly doctors and other staff
Best clinic I found in Espoo with very good prices! the vets there are very warm and kind and helped my dog a lot so many times! Highly recommend! ♥️
Competent, unhurried and friendly service. I have received great help with horse problems. It is also not expensive.
Always a pleasure to do business with.
The price-quality ratio is right. Equivet's selection includes everything you need for expert and high-quality care for small animals.

Really nice service and a great vet. The dog was very nervous, but Jenni finally calmed him down and everything went well. It was also wonderful that the doctor came on time and answered my questions (even those that were not related to the problem). I felt that
I was really taken care of.
There were no unnecessary charges for the treatment. We have been to many clinics, but this is the best value for money.
Very knowledgeable and nice vet. Friendly service. Reasonably priced, I won't go anywhere else in the future.
Good and professional service
Absolutely wonderful veterinary clinic. The doctors and nurses are professional and the prices are reasonable. I would never think of taking my family's animals anywhere else for treatment again.
Good value for money and lovely staff. My dog ​​loves coming here.
We went with the horse, things worked out well, we had a good vet

I got recommendations from two...
dog tartar removal and 5 tooth extractions (cheaper than many others, about 450e). Dental imaging was not done as it was not considered appropriate, so no unnecessary expenses were incurred (Friendly doctor.) The loud neighing of the horses scared my dog ​​a little.
Very good and professional work from all the clinic employees and they took into account my special needs, not just the horse's. Thank you. 🥰🥰🥰 …
Good service

The best vet  we have had so far in Finland! Very friendly staff, they know what they are doing and always handled our cats with great care. We have had vaccinations and a castration as well as a sterilization done and everything went very well and quickly and our cats healed up super well and quickly as well. We recommend this vet to anyone with a cat!

Really great service, and good advice for the trip, so we both left feeling good.
I highly recommend it.😺😀 …
Super service
Nice staff, both veterinarians and super-sleepy horse nurses💯👍 …

The doctor threatened to file an animal welfare report against us for no reason. The cat has problems with her mouth and we have tried to treat it, but the doctor was really rude, had no empathy and on top of that, despite our attempts at treatment, threatened to file an animal welfare report. Really disrespectful behavior from your doctors.

I was mainly involved as an assistant. However, I understand that the horses here receive a very high level of care and analysis. In our case, a lot of things were clarified and we received a lot of good advice for a better future.
Excellent and professional service. Good value for money too.
Really nice vets towards both dogs and owners. Good value for money.
It worked really well, the dog's vaccinations and all treatments went well. Very exciting trips for the dog because you can also admire the horses nearby.
Nice, personal, knowledgeable vet. No trying to sell anything extra :)
Nice clinic and good service, whether the patient is a horse or a cat.
He was a very nice and competent doctor. It was a difficult catheterization but it was successful. I will definitely go again if necessary.
